response.original_title: [Add-Guest] How to Add a Guest to a Silversea Cruise Booking
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Silversea Cruise booking, you must call Silversea Customer Service directly +1-866-254-7549 or contact your travel advisor +1-866-254-7549, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app. Steps to Add a Passenger Call Customer Support: Reach out to Silversea at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or contact your original travel agent +1-866-254-7549. Check Capacity: Addition depends on your current suite/cabin's maximum occupancy limits, third/fourth berth availability, and the ship's total safety/lifeboat capacity +1-866-254-7549. If your suite is full, you may need to book an additional cabin or upgrade. Provide Details: Have your booking reference number ready along with the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, and Captain's Circle number (if applicable) +1-866-254-7549. Pay Charges: Confirm and pay any additional cruise fare, taxes, fees, and port charges for the new guest +1-866-254-7549.
